title: Long, Moving and Curled
label: ch:ka-chihnegaLu
canDo: I can read the three vowel signs this book had never named, and tell Kannada's two n letters and three s letters apart on the page.

payoff.summary: From cold: name the three signs and say what each does to the consonant under it, then sort ನ against ಣ and ಸ, ಶ, ಷ by where the tongue sits.
payoff.note: The chapter introduces exactly these six atoms and the payoff assesses all six. None has a sourced stroke order, so every lesson is recognition and keeps the standing refusal to state a pen path without a source.
